enabled.name: Enable Foundry War
enabled.hint: Enable the features provided by this module.

troopTypes.name: Troop types
troopTypes.hint: Comma-separated list of troop types shown in the War dialog, e.g. Infantry, Cavalry, Archers.

battleAlpha.name: Per-round chaos
battleAlpha.hint: 0 = deterministic, 0.15 = recommended, 1 = very random. Changes losses, not who wins.

battleSwing.name: Swing (battle surprise)
battleSwing.hint: Fixed luck/morale for the whole battle. Higher means numbers matter less. 0.05 = recommended.

battleCompression.name: Force compression
battleCompression.hint: Compresses the force ratio: higher means more troops are needed for the same advantage. 0.2 = recommended.

battleTotalThreshold.name: Total victory threshold
battleTotalThreshold.hint: The winner's margin must reach this percentage of their initial troops. 80% = recommended.

troopType.name: Troop type
troopType.hint: Troop types can be edited in the module settings.

panel.title: War Panel
panel.rushHint: Without Rush losses are capped at 50% of troops. With Rush maximum losses apply.

battle.title: Battle
battle.noRoll: Press Roll 0–100 to draw an outcome from the curve.
battle.name: Name
battle.noPermission: You do not have permission to apply the losses.
battle.emptySide: Both sides need at least one unit to simulate a battle.

warnings.noActor: Select a token or open an actor sheet first.
warnings.noPermission: You do not have permission to configure this actor.
